frontmatter.title: Helios
frontmatter.summary: Helios is a workflow platform that runs medical translation projects end to end — from file intake to vendor coordination, delivery, and invoicing. It replaced a process run on email and spreadsheets with one auditable system.

frontmatter.title: Quoting
frontmatter.summary: Quoting is a quote-management platform that turns a healthcare translation request into an accurate, versioned price quote. It centralizes pricing rules, tracks every revision, and hands approved quotes straight to delivery.

frontmatter.title: AListEngine
frontmatter.summary: AListEngine is an AI tool that turns product photos into ready-to-publish listings for e-commerce stores and auction houses. It drafts the title, description, and price, then exports to Shopify, AuctionFlex, and LiveAuctioneers.

frontmatter.title: NEPSE Trade Journal
frontmatter.summary: A full-stack trading journal for Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE) traders: plan, execute, and review trades, keep a daily journal, track a portfolio, and see analytics like win rate, P&L, and expectancy.
